# egmifs

`egmifs` implements extended generalized monotone incremental forward stagewise regression (eGMIFS) as a modular R/Rcpp/C++ solution-path framework. Built-in NB2 and Poisson components can be combined with custom family, link, fused family-link, and information-criterion plugins.

For the complete user-facing examples, see `README.md` and the package vignettes.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Alihanan/egmifs")
```

## Basic usage

```{r example, eval = FALSE}
library(egmifs)
fit <- egmifs(X, y, enet.alpha = 0.75)
summary(fit)
plot(fit)
```
